INTERTEXTUALITY IN THE PRESENTATION OF THE THEME OF VIOLENCE IN THE NOVEL MSICHANA WA MBALAMWEZI BY K.W. WAMITILA. Authors of the modern Swahili novel convey messages to the audience by focusing on experimental literary techniques. Intertextuality is one of the key elements of those experimental techniques. The novels themselves have been called “experimental novels” or “modern novels.” Other experts have classified them as “Twenty-First Century novels.” The author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila is one of the modern writers who employs this new writing style to address various issues affecting society. The theory of postmodernism has guided this research in the analysis of the aspect of intertextuality. Various types of texts referenced in the presentation of the theme of violence were identified and explained. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi was deliberately selected because it is presented through numerous short narratives that reference different texts. The descriptive content analysis method was used to analyze the data related to the overall issue of intertextuality. The data was analyzed by focusing on themes, settings, and key elements of experimental writing techniques. The findings were presented descriptively. It was revealed that a lack of order in the conduct of affairs is the true reflection of today's society. The referenced texts have shown that the ordinary citizen has been oppressed and provided with poor services by the leaders. This article has examined and evaluated how the author uses the technique of intertextuality as a device for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Janice M. Introduction:- 1.1 Introduction This article addresses the issue of intertextuality as a tool for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi (2011) by Kyallo Wadi Wamitila. The main objective is to identify the various types of texts referenced in the effort to present the theme of oppression. Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory. Address:–Egerton University, Kenya. 1.2 Summary of the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi The main character in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is Yosi Kanga. He has had a good job and a good life. One day, things changed for her soon after she celebrated her thirty-fifth birthday. Yosi Kanga left the office at one o’clock for the afternoon break. She lay down in the garden, and soon sleep carried her away. He had a dream in which he was in danger. In that dream, a certain girl whom he knew as the msichana wa mbalamwezi saved him. He went to get lunch at a hotel near the headquarters of the Kenya Railways Corporation. After lunch, he suddenly collapses and falls ill. He was taken to City Breeze Hospital and admitted there. The doctor said that Yosi Kanga had a tumor in his head and, because of that, he had a short time to live. The services in the hospital were not good. The doctors and some of the staff mistreated the patients. Many of those patients died in ways that were not understood. Later, a female doctor visited her. The moment he saw her, Yosi was overcome by a certain feeling. He tried to remember where he had seen that doctor before. The doctor checked on his condition and after a brief conversation decided to break the news to him. Examinations and all ECG scan reports showed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor instructed him to prepare to leave the hospital. Yosi was very happy because the “death sentence” he had been given in the hospital was revoked. So this was his savior, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions. Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism. Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques. Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing. Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe. At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001). These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film. Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized. European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism. Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved. Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.” According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century. It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others. Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives. A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others. Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures. The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature. Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms. The writer gives himself permission to use another artist’s work to create a new one. With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Wamitila in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi to present the theme of oppression. Furthermore, it has analyzed how these texts were used in conveying the theme of oppression. This research focused on the aspect of intertextuality. Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic. This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance. One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006). This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society. Popular performance uses popular language. Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel. 1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning. Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.” This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts. (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes. In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing. All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author. According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts. This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other. Jilala (2016) explains that the meaning of one text is derived from other texts. In literature, meaning is represented by themes (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality in the selected novel has manifested at various levels such as form, characterization, motif, and themes. This article has identified the types of texts referenced in presenting the theme of oppression. Enani (2005) asserts that intertextuality influences the way a new text is read. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi has demonstrated the presence of stylistic intermingling. Many of the references in this novel are of different styles and have influenced the narrative structure and plot. The audience is taken here and there. The reader starts reading one segment of the story, and before finishing it, another begins. This phenomenon results in complexity within the story itself. Wamitila (2010) asserts that this type of reference can lead to either negative or positive outcomes. Bakhtin (1981:271) argues that what is said is more than just the utterances themselves. Different contexts affect literary works in various ways. Contexts such as economic, social, or political factors influence certain relationships within literary works (Wamitila, 2010). Accordingly, this article has analyzed and critiqued the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, identifying the different types of contexts referenced, their relationships, and how those relationships contribute to presenting the theme of oppression. 1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry. The author K.W. Wamitila has used the element of intertextuality to illustrate the decay and oppression present in his society. This article has demonstrated how "ordinary" citizens are tormented by life in their country due to being deprived of essential services. This section has thoroughly explained the types of texts referenced by the author in his communication with society concerning oppression. 1.5.1 Philosophical Texts According to Lyotard (1997), postmodernism is based on the application of philosophical ideas in composition. Internal pressures and challenges are best understood when related to a particular philosophy or body of scholarship. However, philosophical texts can be complex for readers (Mwamzandi, 2013). The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is dominated by short narratives that refer to the opinions of philosophers. The philosophy of existentialism has led the author to accept that the oppression he experiences in the hospital is just one step in the journey toward his ultimate fate, which is death. The environment of the hospital where Yosi Kanga, the main character in this novel, was admitted was deplorable. The author notes that the beds were old. He describes this situation by saying, “…the metal frames were worn and had started to show patches of rust here and there, the thin sisal mattress was covered with a sheet that had lost its color and resembled a garment soaked in water, leaving stains all over.” (MWM. Ok. 25). The patient referred to had already been told by the doctor that they had a short time to live. Basically, even a patient in a critical condition needs to be given their human rights. The situation in the hospital disheartens him even more. This is because it oppresses him and denies him the right to quality care, even though he knew his fate was death. Moreover, he is oppressed emotionally to the point where he consoles himself with existential thoughts: “…I will rest when I am dead after a few days, and as our people say, the numbered days are few—they pass in the blink of an eye.” (MWM. p.48). According to Diegner (2005), the philosophy of existentialism holds that the ultimate fate of human beings is death. It does not matter whether she has a good job or not. Aside from having a good job that covered her medical expenses, the only solution for Yosi Kanga was death. 1.5.2. Religious texts (the Christian religion, indigenous religions) indicate that Yosi Kanga had health problems since the past which were caused by childhood accidents. Whenever she faced a problem, she was taken to the hospital on a stretcher with a wheel that made a lot of noise. Every time the neighbor's children heard the noise of that stretcher’s wheel, they knew Yosi was being taken to the hospital. Those children stood near the wire fence of their fruit farm and made mocking and derisive gestures at him. The author says, “I wished I had the power of the Biblical David. I would climb onto that cart, look for a wild tunguja fruit or perhaps even a pebble, and strike them on their foreheads to silence their Goliath” (MWM). Page. 21). Yosi saw the neighborhood children as the Goliath of the Bible, who oppressed and mocked the children of Israel. According to the Christian religion, Goliath's oppression of the Israelites was ended by a young boy, David, who slung a stone and killed him. Yosi wished that if he had the strength of David, he would silence those children who laughed at him and belittled him. Moreover, he likens their laughter to Goliath. Earlier, the character Konzi owned a hotel where he worked together with his wife. The author explains that Konzi used to mistreat women, but this habit ended when he got married. However, he continued to offend his wife by desiring other women who came to the hotel, right before his wife’s eyes. Konzi’s wife, whose name is Tabitha, views this behavior as disobedience to the Creator. The one being referred to as the Creator is Almighty God. For Tabitha, such abuse is an act of disobedience to one of the Ten Commandments of God, which warns against adultery as recorded in the Bible (Exodus 20). Tabitha retaliated against her husband by abusing him even more. The author says that Tabitha burst into loud laughter, turning this way and that as if seeking the companionship of others. Finally, she asked her husband whether he really knew her well. Tabitha ended by saying, “If you’re a snake, then I’m the master at drawing out its poison!” (MWM. p.51). The text referred to in this narrative is superstitious. The author Wamitila explains that after this strange event, Mr. Konzi was unable to pass stool or urinate. He was unable to reach the hotel again, “to see those women with faces like tomatoes or to spread butter on their bread” (MWM. Okay. 51). It is evident that his wife used witchcraft to bewitch her husband in an attempt to control him because of "external influences." Moreover, when Konzi was taken to Machakos General Hospital, the doctors were unable to help him. The writer says that even X-ray images did not show any problem. When his abdomen was examined with a stethoscope, the sound heard resembled a rooster crowing. He was advised by the doctor to return home, where his wife laughed and scolded him. Later, she gave him a light slap on the cheek, and the problem of the lump disappeared. It has been revealed that Tabitha used supernatural powers to punish anyone who disrespected her, especially her husband, Konzi. When a community lacks appropriate mechanisms for ensuring justice, it seeks its own means. In this context, the method used by Tabitha disrupts order and morality within the community. Normally, a wife takes care of and respects her husband in every way. 1.5.3 Academic Texts The doctor told the character Yosi Kanga that the health problem he was experiencing was caused by a swelling on his head. He went on to mention that he did not have many days left to live. The author uses the following words to describe this situation: “It seems… hmm… he has a problem of brain tumour… or even intracranial hypertension…! If my diagnosis is correct, because I have never been wrong in all my years of medical practice, he has about twenty-eight days to live… in fact it might even be less!” Academic texts have been used to torment Yosi mentally and emotionally. The examination was not conducted properly because it is later revealed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor boasted of being a scholar who had studied medicine at renowned institutions, “an alumnus of prestigious universities” (MWM). Yes. 31). Thus, when he spoke about his patient’s condition, Joseph knew and believed the truth that his days on earth had come to an end. 1.5.4 Political Texts  
The political situation often oppresses members of society. It has been observed that in many developing countries, politicians use young people to advance their own interests. The author of the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi narrates a story concerning soldiers. He explains that their faces reminded him of the “gangs of men” used by the wealthy to threaten their debtors (MWM). Page. 106). Similarly, the author narrates about the character Moylee Gaga, who bought a house in the Golden Gate neighborhood at an auction after the homeowner failed to pay his mortgage while still living inside. The homeowner needed to move out of the house that had gotten a new owner. The person who bought it did not know how to evict the occupant, so Moylee Gaga was advised to find a gang of youths, as politicians do, give them money to buy alcohol on Madongokuinama Street, then have them go there at night and throw out the homeowner’s belongings, regardless of the crying and shouting from his family (MWM). Uk. 106 – 107). Here, even though the homeowner failed to pay the mortgage, their eviction was carried out in a manner that was unjust and abusive. Another political term that was used is the word “operation” (MWM). Op. 107). This word illustrates how society suffers at the hands of those who are expected to protect it. Moylee Gaga is further advised, "just make sure that the chief of police in that area is aware—I think you understand me—that you simply have a certain 'operation'; as long as he knows, then you have absolutely nothing to fear." Everything will go smoothly. Political language is evident in the words and actions of the various actors mentioned in this context. Njogu (1987) found in his study that the lower class (those living in Madongokuinama) constantly fight against the elite. Contrary to this study, the oppressed appear to accept their situation. Moreover, they accept being “used” by the elite in exchange for small items such as alcohol. Those in power abuse their authority to harm others who are in the lower class. Extreme oppression is when the writer says that it is enough for the police chief to simply know about a certain “operation.” This is contrary to the expectations of the community. This is consistent with Kamunde’s (1983) observation that members of the lower class are oppressed by those of the upper class, although they eventually become aware of this and fight for their rights. 1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing. Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights. Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society. The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism. Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism. However, there is a risk that reading and understanding the modern novel requires prior knowledge of many issues related to philosophy, various disciplines, religion, politics, popular language, and others. Siku moja, mambo yalibadilika kwake mara tu baada ya kusherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa ya thelathini na tano. Yosi Kanga aliondoka ofisini saa moja kwa ajili ya mapumziko ya mchana. Alilala kwenye bustani, na mara usingizi ukamchukua. Alikuwa na ndoto ambayo alikuwa hatarini. Katika ndoto hiyo, msichana fulani aliyemfahamu kwa jina la msichana wa mbalamwezi alimuokoa. Alienda kupata chakula cha mchana kwenye hoteli moja karibu na makao makuu ya Shirika la Reli la Kenya. Baada ya chakula cha mchana, ghafla anaanguka na kuugua. Alipelekwa katika Hospitali ya City Breeze na kulazwa hapo. Daktari alisema kuwa Yosi Kanga alikuwa na uvimbe kichwani na, kwa sababu hiyo, alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi. Huduma za hospitali hazikuwa nzuri. Madaktari na baadhi ya wafanyakazi waliwatendea vibaya wagonjwa. Wengi wa wagonjwa hao walikufa kwa njia ambazo hazikueleweka. Baadaye, daktari wa kike alimtembelea. Mara tu alipomwona, Yosi alizidiwa na hisia fulani. Alijaribu kukumbuka ni wapi aliwahi kumuona daktari huyo hapo awali. Daktari aliangalia hali yake na baada ya mazungumzo mafupi aliamua kumpasha habari hiyo. Uchunguzi na ripoti zote za uchunguzi wa ECG zilionyesha kuwa Yosi alikuwa na afya njema. Daktari alimuagiza ajiandae kuondoka hospitalini. Yosi alifurahi sana kwa sababu “hukumu ya kifo” aliyokuwa amepewa hospitalini ilibatilishwa. Basi huyu ndiye alikuwa mwokozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Usasa  
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa katika misingi ya usasa. Jambo kuu la usasa ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za uandishi wa ukweli. Badala ya kuzingatia mfumo wa uhalisia, mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, kama mwandishi wa kisasa, ameandika riwaya hii kwa kuzingatia uhalisia mpya. Rettova (2016) amemtaja Wamitila kuwa ni mwandishi anayeegemea usasa kwa sababu anathamini matumizi ya mbinu za majaribio. Kuingiliana kwa maandishi ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa uandishi wa kisasa. Wanazuoni wamebainisha kuwa ni vigumu kuweka mipaka kati ya usasa na usasa. Usasa unarejelea kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambacho kilifungamana kwa karibu na mabadiliko ya sanaa, haswa kati ya miaka ya 1880 na 1930 huko Uropa. Wakati huo, wanadamu walionyesha uwezo na uwezo wao wa kuunda, kuimarisha, na kuunda mazingira yao kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, kiteknolojia, na majaribio (Best et al., 2001). Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba, zamani, fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanii yalihusisha aina za fasihi kama vile mashairi, tamthilia, riwaya, ngoma na filamu. Mandhari kuu, lugha sahihi, uhalisia, na muundo thabiti ni vipengele muhimu ambavyo vimesisitizwa. Miji ya Ulaya iliyoshuhudia mabadiliko haya ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, na Moscow. Mabadiliko haya yaliitwa Usasa na yalikuwa msingi na msingi wa usasa. Abrams (1993) anashikilia kuwa usasa hutumiwa kueleza na kubainisha vipengele vipya vya dhamira, fani, dhana, na mitindo ya kifasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya karne ya ishirini, yaani, baada ya Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia. Abrams anasisitiza zaidi kwamba sifa zinazorejelewa hutofautiana kulingana na wakosoaji wanaohusika. Wamitila (2007) anasema, “Pamoja na tofauti hizi, wahakiki wengi wanakubali kwamba msingi wa vipengele hivi ni kuondoka kwa misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Magharibi au uliokuwepo awali.” Kulingana na hili, ni dhahiri kwamba usasa ulijitenga kabisa na kaida za utunzi wa fasihi ambazo zilifuatwa kabla ya karne ya ishirini. Ingawa wakati halisi wa kuibuka kwa usasa na usasa ni suala la mjadala, ni wazi kwamba usasa uliibuka na ulijengwa juu ya misingi ya usasa. Usasa uliibuka na ulianzishwa katika karne ya ishirini. Ilihusishwa na Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, kati ya wengine. Wataalamu wengine waliochangia nadharia ya usasa ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987), ambaye anasisitiza kuwa ulimwengu wa kisasa unategemea zaidi vipengele vya usasa, ambapo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na binadamu wa kisasa huchunguzwa kupitia masimulizi mengi. Mfasiri wa hivi karibuni wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala haya yanaangazia mitazamo mbalimbali ya nadharia iliyoasisiwa na Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), na wengine. Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia tata kwamba ufahamu wa wanajamii umebadilishwa sana na mabadiliko yaliyoletwa na kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imepelekea jamii kubadili tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kisasa. Kipindi cha kisasa kilivuruga mipaka iliyowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Jambo hili limedhihirika katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii, ikiwemo fasihi. Maisha na watu sio mpangilio, na kwa hivyo kazi za fasihi hazipaswi kuwa na mpangilio maalum. Usasa unahusishwa kwa karibu na utamaduni maarufu, ambapo watu hufanya mambo kwa njia yoyote wanayotaka bila kufuata kanuni za jadi. Mwandishi anajipa ruhusa ya kutumia kazi ya msanii mwingine kuunda mpya. Kuhusiana na masuala haya, makala haya yamebainisha aina za maandishi yaliyorejelewa na mwandishi K.W. Wamitila katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ili kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji. Zaidi ya hayo, imechanganua jinsi maandishi haya yalivyotumiwa katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji. Utafiti huu ulizingatia kipengele cha uamilishi. Carter (2006) anaeleza kuwa usasa hukiuka kaida na kanuni zote za utunzi. Kanuni ambazo Carter anarejelea zinaweza kuwa za kimuundo au za lugha. Hii ni kusema kwamba, pamoja na fasihi maarufu, modernism pia inahusishwa na utendaji maarufu. Sifa moja inayojulikana sana katika fasihi maarufu ni “mkondo wa fahamu,” ambayo ni mbinu ya masimulizi katika uandishi wa nathari ambayo hutumia maelezo marefu yanayozingatia mawazo yanayopita akilini mwa mhusika (Wamitila, 2006). Utendaji huu unafanyika popote na haufuati utaratibu wowote. Mara nyingi, lengo kuu la mwandishi ni kuburudisha jamii. Utendaji maarufu hutumia lugha maarufu. Kwa kuwa lugha ni chombo muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi, usasa huzingatia matumizi ya lugha kwa njia huru kabisa bila kuzingatia ufasaha au usanifishaji wake. Pia inahusisha kuchanganya lugha mbalimbali, kwa mfano, Kiingereza na Kiswahili au lugha za kwanza na Kiswahili. Dhana hii iliongoza utafiti huu katika kuchanganua masuala mahususi yanayohusu matumizi ya lugha maarufu, hasa uchanganyaji msimbo na ubadilishaji msimbo katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Lugha iliyotumika inarejelea matini mbalimbali zinazowasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji katika jamii. Msingi wa usasa ulitumika kuongoza utafiti katika uchanganuzi wa uamilishi kama mojawapo ya vipengele muhimu vya riwaya za majaribio. Mtafiti amebainisha jinsi kipengele hiki kinavyovuruga mpangilio katika riwaya teule. 1.4 Ulinganifu

Intertextuality ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza “intertextuality,” ambalo lilitumiwa kwa mara ya kwanza na mwanafalsafa wa Kifaransa Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). Kulingana na Kristeva, kila neno ni kumbukumbu ya maneno mengine. Hivyo basi, mkazo huwekwa kwenye wazo kwamba matini zinahusiana na hutegemeana ili kuleta maana. Stam (2000), kama alivyonukuliwa katika Anderson (2004:1), anasema, "Nakala yoyote inayojitokeza lazima iwe pamoja na nyingine, au na maandishi mengine ambayo maandishi ya asili pia yamekuwepo." Kauli hii inadhihirisha kuwa kazi ya fasihi haitokani na akili ya mwandishi pekee au kwenye ombwe, bali ni mkusanyo wa matini mbalimbali. (Anderson, 2004) anadai kwamba mwingiliano wa maandishi unahusisha “kile ambacho tayari kimesemwa.” Muingiliano wa maandishi ni kipengele muhimu cha usasa, ambamo Wamitila anaandika. Kwa kuongeza, intertextuality ni moja ya vipengele muhimu vya maandishi ya majaribio. Mwingiliano wa matini unaojitokeza mara kwa mara katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi unadhihirika kwa matumizi ya hadithi fupi, tanzu za fasihi simulizi, maoni ya kifalsafa, ushairi/nyimbo na kuchanganya lugha. Maandishi haya yote yametumika katika riwaya hii kuwasilisha dhamira ya dhuluma katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii mathalan afya, elimu na mapenzi. Vipengele hivi vyote vinaingiliana na hutegemeana katika kukuza ubunifu wa mwandishi. Kulingana na Julia Kristeva (1980), maandishi yanahusiana na maandishi mengine. Makala haya yamebainisha kuwa katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya dhuluma katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, matini mbalimbali hufungamana, huingiliana, na kutegemeana. Jilala (2016) anaeleza kuwa maana ya matini moja inatokana na maandishi mengine. Katika fasihi, maana huwakilishwa na dhamira (Mohammed, 1995). Mwingiliano wa matini katika riwaya teule umedhihirika katika viwango mbalimbali kama vile umbo, wahusika, motifu na mada. Makala haya yamebainisha aina za matini zilizorejelewa katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji. Enani (2005) anadai kuwa uamilishi huathiri jinsi matini mpya inavyosomwa. Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imedhihirisha uwepo wa mwingiliano wa kimtindo. Marejeleo mengi katika riwaya hii ni ya mitindo tofauti na yameathiri muundo wa masimulizi na ploti. Hadhira inachukuliwa hapa na pale. Msomaji anaanza kusoma sehemu moja ya hadithi, na kabla ya kuimaliza, nyingine huanza. Jambo hili husababisha utata ndani ya hadithi yenyewe. Wamitila (2010) anadai kuwa aina hii ya marejeleo inaweza kuleta matokeo mabaya au chanya. Bakhtin (1981:271) anasema kuwa kinachosemwa ni zaidi ya matamshi yenyewe. Miktadha tofauti huathiri kazi za fasihi kwa njia mbalimbali. Miktadha kama vile mambo ya kiuchumi, kijamii, au kisiasa huathiri uhusiano fulani katika kazi za fasihi (Wamitila, 2010). Kwa mantiki hiyo, makala haya yameichambua na kuihakiki riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, kwa kubainisha aina mbalimbali za miktadha iliyorejelewa, mahusiano yao, na jinsi mahusiano hayo yanavyochangia katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji. 1.5 Marejeleo ya Kimsingi na Uwasilishaji wa Dhamira ya Ukandamizaji katika Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: Mtazamo wa Kisasa.

Nchi zinazoendelea zinakandamiza raia wao kwa njia mbalimbali. Mbinu hizi huonekana wazi hasa katika namna huduma zinavyotolewa. Kwa sababu mbalimbali, ambazo wasanii wenyewe wanaweza kumiliki, ukandamizaji huo unawasilishwa kwa ubunifu kupitia fasihi. Ili kueleza hali hii kikamilifu, mbinu za usimulizi na vifaa vya kifasihi hutumika kwa ustadi na usanii. Mwandishi K.W. Wamitila ametumia kipengele cha uamilishi ili kudhihirisha uozo na ukandamizaji uliopo katika jamii yake. Makala haya yamedhihirisha jinsi wananchi “wa kawaida” wanavyoteswa na maisha katika nchi yao kutokana na kunyimwa huduma muhimu. Sehemu hii imeeleza kwa kina aina za matini zilizorejelewa na mwandishi katika mawasiliano yake na jamii kuhusu dhuluma. 1.5.1 Maandishi ya Kifalsafa Kwa mujibu wa Lyotard (1997), uposasa unatokana na matumizi ya mawazo ya kifalsafa katika utunzi. Shinikizo za ndani na changamoto zinaeleweka vyema zaidi zinapohusiana na falsafa fulani au kikundi cha usomi. Hata hivyo, matini za kifalsafa zinaweza kuwa changamano kwa wasomaji (Mwamzandi, 2013). Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imetawaliwa na masimulizi mafupi yanayorejelea maoni ya wanafalsafa. Falsafa ya udhanaishi imemfanya mwandishi kukubali kuwa dhuluma anayoipata hospitalini ni hatua moja tu ya kuelekea kwenye hatima yake ya mwisho, ambayo ni kifo. Mazingira ya hospitali aliyolazwa Yosi Kanga, mhusika mkuu katika riwaya hii, yalikuwa ya kusikitisha. Mwandishi anabainisha kuwa vitanda vilikuwa vya zamani. Anaelezea hali hii kwa kusema, “… fremu za chuma zilikuwa zimechakaa na zimeanza kuonyesha mabaka ya kutu huku na kule, godoro jembamba la mlonge lilikuwa limefunikwa kwa shuka lililokuwa limepoteza rangi na mithili ya vazi lililolowekwa maji na kuacha madoa mwili mzima. (MWM. Sawa. 25). Mgonjwa aliyerejelewa tayari alikuwa ameambiwa na daktari kwamba walikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi. Kimsingi, hata mgonjwa katika hali mbaya anahitaji kupewa haki zao za kibinadamu. Hali ya hospitalini inamvunja moyo zaidi. Hii ni kwa sababu inamkandamiza na kumnyima haki ya matunzo bora, ingawa alijua hatima yake ni kifo. Zaidi ya hayo, anakandamizwa kihisia hadi kufikia hatua ambapo anajifariji kwa mawazo ya kuwepo: “…Nitapumzika nitakapokufa baada ya siku chache, na kama watu wetu wanavyosema, siku zilizohesabiwa ni chache—zinapita kwa kufumba na kufumbua. (MWM. uk.48). Kulingana na Diegner (2005), falsafa ya udhanaishi inashikilia kwamba hatima ya mwisho ya wanadamu ni kifo. Haijalishi kama ana kazi nzuri au la. Kando na kuwa na kazi nzuri ambayo ilimudu gharama za matibabu, suluhu pekee kwa Yosi Kanga lilikuwa kifo. 1.5.2. Maandiko ya kidini (dini ya Kikristo, dini za kiasili) yanaonyesha kuwa Yosi Kanga alikuwa na matatizo ya kiafya tangu zamani ambayo yalisababishwa na ajali za utotoni. Kila alipopatwa na tatizo, alipelekwa hospitali kwa machela yenye gurudumu lililotoa kelele nyingi. Kila wakati watoto wa jirani waliposikia kelele ya gurudumu la machela, walijua Yosi alikuwa akipelekwa hospitalini. Watoto hao walisimama karibu na uzio wa waya wa shamba lao la matunda na wakamfanyia ishara za dhihaka na dhihaka. Mwandishi anasema, “Laiti ningekuwa na uwezo wa Daudi wa Biblia, ningepanda kwenye mkokoteni huo, nitafute tunda la tunguja pori au pengine hata kokoto, na kuwapiga kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao ili kumnyamazisha Goliathi wao” (MWM). Ukurasa. 21). Yosi aliwaona watoto wa jirani kuwa Goliathi wa Biblia, ambaye aliwakandamiza na kuwadhihaki wana wa Israeli. Kulingana na dini ya Kikristo, ukandamizaji wa Goliathi kwa Waisraeli ulimalizwa na mvulana mdogo, Daudi, ambaye alirusha jiwe na kumuua. Yosi alitamani kwamba ikiwa angekuwa na nguvu za Daudi, angenyamazisha wale watoto waliomcheka na kumdharau. Isitoshe, anafananisha kicheko chao na Goliathi. Hapo awali, mhusika Konzi alikuwa na hoteli ambapo alifanya kazi pamoja na mkewe. Mwandishi anaeleza kuwa Konzi alikuwa akiwatesa wanawake, lakini tabia hii iliisha alipooa. Hata hivyo, aliendelea kumuudhi mke wake kwa kutamani wanawake wengine waliofika kwenye hoteli hiyo, mbele ya macho ya mkewe. Mke wa Konzi, ambaye jina lake ni Tabitha, anaona tabia hii kuwa kutomtii Muumba. Anayetajwa kuwa Muumba ni Mungu Mweza Yote. Kwa Tabitha, unyanyasaji huo ni kitendo cha kutotii mojawapo ya Amri Kumi za Mungu, ambayo inaonya dhidi ya uzinzi kama ilivyoandikwa katika Biblia (Kutoka 20). Tabitha alilipiza kisasi dhidi ya mumewe kwa kumnyanyasa hata zaidi. Mwandishi anasema kwamba Tabitha aliangua kicheko kikubwa, akigeuka huku na kule kana kwamba anatafuta urafiki wa wengine. Hatimaye, alimuuliza mume wake ikiwa kweli anamjua vizuri. Tabitha alimalizia kwa kusema, “Ikiwa wewe ni nyoka, basi mimi ndiye bwana wa kutoa sumu yake!” (MWM. uk.51). Maandishi yanayorejelewa katika simulizi hii ni ya kishirikina. Mwandishi Wamitila anaeleza kuwa baada ya tukio hilo la ajabu, Bwana Konzi hakuweza kutoa kinyesi wala kukojoa. Hakuweza kufika hotelini tena, "kuwaona wale wanawake wenye nyuso kama nyanya au kunyunyiza siagi kwenye mkate wao" (MWM. Sawa. 51). Ni dhahiri kwamba mke wake alitumia uchawi kumroga mumewe ili kujaribu kumdhibiti kwa sababu ya "mvuto wa nje." Aidha, Konzi alipopelekwa katika Hospitali Kuu ya Machakos, madaktari hawakuweza kumsaidia. Mwandishi anasema hata picha za X-ray hazikuonyesha tatizo lolote. Tumbo lake lilipochunguzwa kwa stethoscope, sauti iliyosikika ilifanana na kuwika kwa jogoo. Alishauriwa na daktari kurudi nyumbani, ambapo mkewe alicheka na kumkaripia. Baadaye, alimpiga kofi nyepesi kwenye shavu, na shida ya uvimbe ikatoweka. Imebainika kuwa Tabitha alitumia nguvu zisizo za kawaida kuadhibu mtu yeyote anayemdharau, haswa mumewe, Konzi. Jumuiya inapokosa njia zinazofaa za kuhakikisha haki, inatafuta njia zake yenyewe. Katika muktadha huu, mbinu anayotumia Tabitha inavuruga utaratibu na maadili ndani ya jamii. Kwa kawaida, mke humtunza na kumheshimu mume wake kwa kila jambo. 1.5.3 Maandishi ya Kitaaluma Daktari alimweleza mhusika Yosi Kanga kuwa tatizo la kiafya alilokuwa nalo lilisababishwa na uvimbe kichwani. Aliendelea kutaja kwamba hakuwa na siku nyingi za kuishi. Mwandishi anatumia maneno yafuatayo kuelezea hali hii: “Inaonekana… hmm… ana tatizo la uvimbe wa ubongo… au hata shinikizo la damu kichwani…! Ikiwa utambuzi wangu ni sahihi, kwa sababu sijawahi kukosea katika miaka yangu yote ya udaktari, ana takriban siku ishirini na nane za kuishi… kwa kweli zinaweza kupungua!” Maandishi ya kitaaluma yametumiwa kumtesa Yosi kiakili na kihisia. Uchunguzi haukufanywa ipasavyo kwa sababu baadaye ilibainika kuwa Yosi alikuwa na afya njema. Daktari huyo alijigamba kuwa msomi aliyesomea udaktari katika taasisi maarufu, "mhitimu wa vyuo vikuu vya hadhi" (MWM). Ndiyo. 31). Hivyo, alipozungumza kuhusu hali ya mgonjwa wake, Yosefu alijua na kuamini ukweli kwamba siku zake duniani zilikuwa zimefikia mwisho. 1.5.4 Maandiko ya Siasa  
Hali ya kisiasa mara nyingi huwakandamiza wanajamii. Imeonekana kuwa katika nchi nyingi zinazoendelea, wanasiasa huwatumia vijana kuendeleza maslahi yao binafsi. Mwandishi wa riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi anasimulia kisa kinachowahusu askari. Anaeleza kuwa sura zao zilimkumbusha “magenge ya watu” yanayotumiwa na matajiri kuwatishia wadeni wao (MWM). Ukurasa. 106). Vile vile, mwandishi anasimulia kuhusu mhusika Moylee Gaga, ambaye alinunua nyumba katika mtaa wa Golden Gate kwenye mnada baada ya mwenye nyumba kushindwa kulipa rehani yake akiwa bado anaishi ndani. Mmiliki wa nyumba alihitaji kuondoka katika nyumba ambayo ilikuwa imepata mmiliki mpya. Aliyeinunua hakujua jinsi ya kumfukuza mwenye nyumba, hivyo Moylee Gaga alishauriwa atafute genge la vijana, kama wanasiasa wanavyofanya, awape pesa ya kununua pombe kwenye mtaa wa Madongokuinama, kisha waende huko usiku na kutupa vitu vya mwenye nyumba, bila kujali kilio na kelele kutoka kwa familia yake (MWM). Uk. 106 – 107). Hapa, ingawa mwenye nyumba alishindwa kulipa rehani, kufukuzwa kwao kulifanywa kwa njia isiyo ya haki na ya dhuluma. Neno lingine la kisiasa ambalo lilitumika ni neno "operesheni" (MWM). Washa. 107). Neno hili linaonyesha jinsi jamii inavyoteseka mikononi mwa wale wanaotarajiwa kuilinda. Moylee Gaga anashauriwa zaidi, "hakikisha tu kwamba mkuu wa polisi katika eneo hilo anafahamu-nadhani unanielewa-kwamba una 'operesheni' fulani tu; mradi anajua, basi huna chochote cha kuogopa." Kila kitu kitaenda sawa. Lugha ya kisiasa inaonekana wazi katika maneno na matendo ya wahusika mbalimbali waliotajwa katika muktadha huu. Njogu (1987) aligundua katika utafiti wake kwamba tabaka la chini (wale wanaoishi Madongokuinama) wanapigana kila mara dhidi ya wasomi. Kinyume na utafiti huu, wanyonge wanaonekana kukubali hali yao. Zaidi ya hayo, wanakubali "kutumiwa" na wasomi badala ya vitu vidogo kama vile pombe. Wale walio madarakani wanatumia vibaya mamlaka yao kuwadhuru wengine walio katika tabaka la chini. Ukandamizaji uliokithiri ni wakati mwandishi anaposema kwamba inatosha kwa mkuu wa polisi kujua tu kuhusu “operesheni” fulani. Hii ni kinyume na matarajio ya jamii. Hili linaafikiana na maoni ya Kamunde (1983) kwamba watu wa tabaka la chini wanakandamizwa na watu wa tabaka la juu, ingawa hatimaye wanalifahamu hili na kupigania haki zao. 1.6 Hitimisho  
Kifungu hiki kimethibitisha kwamba maana, maadili na ukweli hupatikana bila kutegemea njia au mtazamo mmoja, kwa sababu chanzo chao cha kweli ni jamii. Ukandamizaji katika jamii umewasilishwa kupitia matumizi ya uandishi wa maandishi, ambayo ni kipengele cha maandishi ya majaribio. Maandishi mbalimbali yakiwemo ya kifalsafa, kidini, kitaaluma na kisiasa yametumika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji katika riwaya ya *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. Mwandishi ametumia masimulizi mafupi yenye marejeleo mahususi ya kimaana kuonesha jinsi wanajamii wanavyonyimwa haki zao. Vile vile, imedhihirika kuwa ukosefu wa mpangilio katika maisha ya kisasa unadhihirika katika fasihi ya kisasa. Walakini, ingawa shida katika kufanya shughuli mbali mbali zinaweza kuonekana kuwa haitoshi, inatosha katika fasihi. Ukosefu huu kwa kweli ni uwakilishi wa kweli wa maisha ya kisasa, yaani, picha kamili ya jamii ya leo. Riwaya ya sasa ya Kiswahili inafaa kwa sababu inatumika kama kiakisi halisi cha jamii ya leo. Imedhihirika kuwa masimulizi mafupi yanayorejelea matini mbalimbali yanafaa katika kuwasilisha dhamira, badala ya kutumia hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa kwa mtindo wa uhalisia. Muumbaji yeyote ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya katika kutekeleza kazi yake bila kuwekewa vikwazo au kuwekewa sheria za kitamaduni. Kwa hivyo, mwandishi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kufanya majaribio ya mbinu mpya za uandishi bila kubanwa na mbinu za kimapokeo ambazo zimekitwa katika uhalisia. Hata hivyo, kuna hatari kwamba kusoma na kuelewa riwaya ya kisasa kunahitaji ujuzi wa awali wa masuala mengi yanayohusiana na falsafa, taaluma mbalimbali, dini, siasa, lugha maarufu, na wengine. 1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions.
discourses.translated_txt:
Basi huyu ndiye alikuwa mwokozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Usasa  
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa katika misingi ya usasa. Jambo kuu la usasa ni ukiukaji wa kanuni za uandishi wa ukweli.

discourses.source_txt: Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Badala ya kuzingatia mfumo wa uhalisia, mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, kama mwandishi wa kisasa, ameandika riwaya hii kwa kuzingatia uhalisia mpya.

discourses.source_txt: Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques.
discourses.translated_txt: Rettova (2016) amemtaja Wamitila kuwa ni mwandishi anayeegemea usasa kwa sababu anathamini matumizi ya mbinu za majaribio.

discourses.source_txt: Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing.
discourses.translated_txt: Kuingiliana kwa maandishi ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa uandishi wa kisasa.

discourses.source_txt: Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe.
discourses.translated_txt: Wanazuoni wamebainisha kuwa ni vigumu kuweka mipaka kati ya usasa na usasa. Usasa unarejelea kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambacho kilifungamana kwa karibu na mabadiliko ya sanaa, haswa kati ya miaka ya 1880 na 1930 huko Uropa.

discourses.source_txt: At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001).
discourses.translated_txt: Wakati huo, wanadamu walionyesha uwezo na uwezo wao wa kuunda, kuimarisha, na kuunda mazingira yao kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, kiteknolojia, na majaribio (Best et al., 2001).

discourses.source_txt: These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film.
discourses.translated_txt: Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba, zamani, fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanii yalihusisha aina za fasihi kama vile mashairi, tamthilia, riwaya, ngoma na filamu.

discourses.source_txt: Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized.
discourses.translated_txt: Mandhari kuu, lugha sahihi, uhalisia, na muundo thabiti ni vipengele muhimu ambavyo vimesisitizwa.

discourses.source_txt: European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism.
discourses.translated_txt: Miji ya Ulaya iliyoshuhudia mabadiliko haya ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, na Moscow. Mabadiliko haya yaliitwa Usasa na yalikuwa msingi na msingi wa usasa.

discourses.source_txt: Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved.
discourses.translated_txt: Abrams (1993) anashikilia kuwa usasa hutumiwa kueleza na kubainisha vipengele vipya vya dhamira, fani, dhana, na mitindo ya kifasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya karne ya ishirini, yaani, baada ya Vita Kuu ya Pili ya Dunia. Abrams anasisitiza zaidi kwamba sifa zinazorejelewa hutofautiana kulingana na wakosoaji wanaohusika.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.”
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2007) anasema, “Pamoja na tofauti hizi, wahakiki wengi wanakubali kwamba msingi wa vipengele hivi ni kuondoka kwa misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Magharibi au uliokuwepo awali.”

discourses.source_txt: According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century.
discourses.translated_txt: Kulingana na hili, ni dhahiri kwamba usasa ulijitenga kabisa na kaida za utunzi wa fasihi ambazo zilifuatwa kabla ya karne ya ishirini. Ingawa wakati halisi wa kuibuka kwa usasa na usasa ni suala la mjadala, ni wazi kwamba usasa uliibuka na ulijengwa juu ya misingi ya usasa. Usasa uliibuka na ulianzishwa katika karne ya ishirini.

discourses.source_txt: It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others.
discourses.translated_txt: Ilihusishwa na Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, kati ya wengine.

discourses.source_txt: Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives.
discourses.translated_txt: Wataalamu wengine waliochangia nadharia ya usasa ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987), ambaye anasisitiza kuwa ulimwengu wa kisasa unategemea zaidi vipengele vya usasa, ambapo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na binadamu wa kisasa huchunguzwa kupitia masimulizi mengi.

discourses.source_txt: A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfasiri wa hivi karibuni wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala haya yanaangazia mitazamo mbalimbali ya nadharia iliyoasisiwa na Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), na wengine.

discourses.source_txt: Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures.
discourses.translated_txt: Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia tata kwamba ufahamu wa wanajamii umebadilishwa sana na mabadiliko yaliyoletwa na kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imepelekea jamii kubadili tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kisasa.

discourses.source_txt: The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature.
discourses.translated_txt: Kipindi cha kisasa kilivuruga mipaka iliyowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Jambo hili limedhihirika katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii, ikiwemo fasihi.

discourses.source_txt: Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms.
discourses.translated_txt: Maisha na watu sio mpangilio, na kwa hivyo kazi za fasihi hazipaswi kuwa na mpangilio maalum. Usasa unahusishwa kwa karibu na utamaduni maarufu, ambapo watu hufanya mambo kwa njia yoyote wanayotaka bila kufuata kanuni za jadi.

Utafiti huu ulizingatia kipengele cha uamilishi.

discourses.source_txt: Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic.

discourses.source_txt: This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance.
discourses.translated_txt: Hii ni kusema kwamba, pamoja na fasihi maarufu, modernism pia inahusishwa na utendaji maarufu.

discourses.source_txt: One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006).
discourses.translated_txt: Sifa moja inayojulikana sana katika fasihi maarufu ni “mkondo wa fahamu,” ambayo ni mbinu ya masimulizi katika uandishi wa nathari ambayo hutumia maelezo marefu yanayozingatia mawazo yanayopita akilini mwa mhusika (Wamitila, 2006).

discourses.source_txt: This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society.
discourses.translated_txt: Utendaji huu unafanyika popote na haufuati utaratibu wowote. Mara nyingi, lengo kuu la mwandishi ni kuburudisha jamii.

discourses.source_txt: Popular performance uses popular language.
discourses.translated_txt: Utendaji maarufu hutumia lugha maarufu.

discourses.source_txt: Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuwa lugha ni chombo muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi, usasa huzingatia matumizi ya lugha kwa njia huru kabisa bila kuzingatia ufasaha au usanifishaji wake. discourses.source_txt:
1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning.
discourses.translated_txt:
1.4 Ulinganifu

Intertextuality ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza “intertextuality,” ambalo lilitumiwa kwa mara ya kwanza na mwanafalsafa wa Kifaransa Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). Kulingana na Kristeva, kila neno ni kumbukumbu ya maneno mengine. Hivyo basi, mkazo huwekwa kwenye wazo kwamba matini zinahusiana na hutegemeana ili kuleta maana.

discourses.source_txt: Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.”
discourses.translated_txt: Stam (2000), kama alivyonukuliwa katika Anderson (2004:1), anasema, "Nakala yoyote inayojitokeza lazima iwe pamoja na nyingine, au na maandishi mengine ambayo maandishi ya asili pia yamekuwepo."

discourses.source_txt: This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Kauli hii inadhihirisha kuwa kazi ya fasihi haitokani na akili ya mwandishi pekee au kwenye ombwe, bali ni mkusanyo wa matini mbalimbali.

discourses.source_txt: (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes.
discourses.translated_txt: (Anderson, 2004) anadai kwamba mwingiliano wa maandishi unahusisha “kile ambacho tayari kimesemwa.” Muingiliano wa maandishi ni kipengele muhimu cha usasa, ambamo Wamitila anaandika.

discourses.source_txt: In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuongeza, intertextuality ni moja ya vipengele muhimu vya maandishi ya majaribio. Mwingiliano wa matini unaojitokeza mara kwa mara katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi unadhihirika kwa matumizi ya hadithi fupi, tanzu za fasihi simulizi, maoni ya kifalsafa, ushairi/nyimbo na kuchanganya lugha.

discourses.source_txt: All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author.
discourses.translated_txt: Maandishi haya yote yametumika katika riwaya hii kuwasilisha dhamira ya dhuluma katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii mathalan afya, elimu na mapenzi. Vipengele hivi vyote vinaingiliana na hutegemeana katika kukuza ubunifu wa mwandishi.

discourses.source_txt: According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Kulingana na Julia Kristeva (1980), maandishi yanahusiana na maandishi mengine.

discourses.source_txt: This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other.
discourses.translated_txt: Makala haya yamebainisha kuwa katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya dhuluma katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, matini mbalimbali hufungamana, huingiliana, na kutegemeana.

discourses.source_txt: Jilala (2016) explains that the meaning of one text is derived from other texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Jilala (2016) anaeleza kuwa maana ya matini moja inatokana na maandishi mengine.

discourses.source_txt: In literature, meaning is represented by themes (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality in the selected novel has manifested at various levels such as form, characterization, motif, and themes.
discourses.translated_txt: Katika fasihi, maana huwakilishwa na dhamira (Mohammed, 1995). Mwingiliano wa matini katika riwaya teule umedhihirika katika viwango mbalimbali kama vile umbo, wahusika, motifu na mada.

discourses.source_txt: This article has identified the types of texts referenced in presenting the theme of oppression. Enani (2005) asserts that intertextuality influences the way a new text is read.
discourses.translated_txt: Makala haya yamebainisha aina za matini zilizorejelewa katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji. Enani (2005) anadai kuwa uamilishi huathiri jinsi matini mpya inavyosomwa.

discourses.source_txt:
1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry.

1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing.

discourses.translated_txt: Maandishi mbalimbali yakiwemo ya kifalsafa, kidini, kitaaluma na kisiasa yametumika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji katika riwaya ya *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*.

discourses.source_txt: The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights.
discourses.translated_txt: Mwandishi ametumia masimulizi mafupi yenye marejeleo mahususi ya kimaana kuonesha jinsi wanajamii wanavyonyimwa haki zao.

discourses.source_txt: Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society.
discourses.translated_txt: Vile vile, imedhihirika kuwa ukosefu wa mpangilio katika maisha ya kisasa unadhihirika katika fasihi ya kisasa. Walakini, ingawa shida katika kufanya shughuli mbali mbali zinaweza kuonekana kuwa haitoshi, inatosha katika fasihi. Ukosefu huu kwa kweli ni uwakilishi wa kweli wa maisha ya kisasa, yaani, picha kamili ya jamii ya leo.

discourses.source_txt: The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Riwaya ya sasa ya Kiswahili inafaa kwa sababu inatumika kama kiakisi halisi cha jamii ya leo. Imedhihirika kuwa masimulizi mafupi yanayorejelea matini mbalimbali yanafaa katika kuwasilisha dhamira, badala ya kutumia hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa kwa mtindo wa uhalisia.

discourses.source_txt: Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Muumbaji yeyote ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya katika kutekeleza kazi yake bila kuwekewa vikwazo au kuwekewa sheria za kitamaduni. Kwa hivyo, mwandishi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kufanya majaribio ya mbinu mpya za uandishi bila kubanwa na mbinu za kimapokeo ambazo zimekitwa katika uhalisia.

discourses.source_txt: However, there is a risk that reading and understanding the modern novel requires prior knowledge of many issues related to philosophy, various disciplines, religion, politics, popular language, and others.
discourses.translated_txt: Hata hivyo, kuna hatari kwamba kusoma na kuelewa riwaya ya kisasa kunahitaji ujuzi wa awali wa masuala mengi yanayohusiana na falsafa, taaluma mbalimbali, dini, siasa, lugha maarufu, na wengine.
